assertion.statement: The retained integral Euler system is defined on every index required by Kato1999 and satisfies both norm cases; its divisor-parameter-one Iwasawa class is exactly the supplied retained dyadic class, so the K15 coordinate ideal refers to that class rather than a rescaled generator.
assertion.objects: N_K=2Nd, Nprime=c*d_s, the same original z_(Dm), symbol, smoothers, integral lattice T*chi, and retained class y_(2^infinity).
assertion.hypotheses: The stated K5 coprimality, original2004 class construction and norm identities, and the separate rational hypotheses of the1999 theorem are supplied. Only the stated uniform lattice comparison is permitted.
assertion.quantifiers: Every m divisible by N_K and coprime to Nprime; every repeated or new prime in the norm relation; every n>=1 for the cofinal dyadic class comparison.
assertion.parameter_range: Prime two with localization at height-one primes away from2; the fixed actual elliptic representation and quadratic character.
assertion.uniformity: One uniform2^c_E lattice comparison applies across the complete retained index family.
assertion.normalizations: Arithmetic Frobenius on T*chi, inverse deck element in Euler substitution; distinguish source divisor parameter1 from conductor d. The1999 full-cohomology scheme and2004 j-star construction are related by the stated local-complex comparison.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Repeated bad or conductor primes have factor1; new primes outside2Nd contribute P_l(l^-1 sigma_l^-1); smoothing primes excluded; n>=1 is cofinal; no odd-prime-only theorem is invoked at2.
assertion.limit_order: Construct the full index family first, verify both norm cases, identify the actual dyadic class by corestriction, then compare local complexes preserving that class and its coordinate ideal J.
